title: With announce.to_other_sessions false in a settings.json that is not valid JSON, the coord hook posts the session's intent
goal: the coord hook posts no intent when the workspace's settings.json sets announce.to_other_sessions to false, also when the file has a syntax error such as a trailing comma

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, sys, json, uuid, glob
REAL = os.getcwd()
S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), "c.sqlite")
sid = str(uuid.uuid4())
d = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp())
for a in (["init", "-q", "-b", "work/ST-ef56gh78"], ["commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "-m", "x"]):
    subprocess.run(["git", "-c", "user.email=a@b.c", "-c", "user.name=x", "-C", d] + a, capture_output=True)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, "_backlog"))
json.dump({"id": "ST-ef56gh78", "title": "t", "touches": ["a.py"]}, open(os.path.join(d, "_backlog", "ST-ef56gh78.json"), "w"))
open(os.path.join(d, "settings.json"), "w").write(json.dumps({"coordination": {"announce": {"to_other_sessions": False}}}).replace("false}", "false,}"))
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, ".claude/hooks/coord_hook.py"], input=json.dumps(dict(hook_event_name="SessionStart", session_id=sid, cwd=d, source="startup")), capture_output=True, text=True, env=dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S, KB_OPERATOR="op-aaaa"), cwd=REAL)
w = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/coord.py", "--store", S, "wait", "--since", "0", "--timeout", "0"], capture_output=True, text=True)
n = [e for e in json.loads(w.stdout)["events"] if e["kind"] == "intent" and e["fields"].get("session") == sid]
for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(REAL, "_cache", "coord_hook", sid + "*")):
    os.remove(f)
print("exit", r.returncode, "| intents posted with to_other_sessions false in a settings file that is not valid JSON:", len(n))
sys.exit(0 if r.returncode == 0 and not n else 1)

gates.question: How does the coord hook read announce.to_other_sessions from a settings.json that is not valid JSON?
options: regex over the file text for the first "to_other_sessions": true|false
strip trailing commas and parse again
gates.recommendation: regex over the file text for the first "to_other_sessions": true|false
gates.reason: it covers any syntax error, not only a trailing comma
gates.answer: regex over the file text for the first "to_other_sessions": true|false
